subject: Supplier activation: PO flow, onboarding forms & early-pay scorecard
messages:
From: Elise Moran <elise.moran@wavepay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: WavePay AP <ap@wavepay.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding + early-pay options for WavePay

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — WavePay is really excited about potential throughput gains once we move to dedicated capacity. Before we sign the PO, our finance team asked if we can explore an early-pay option on a partial subset of invoices for the first two quarters. Specifically: would Redwood consider a 2% discount for payments within 10 days for invoices under $50k?

Also: we wanted to confirm the PO flow and vendor onboarding checklist so our AP team can set up payments smoothly. Can you share the onboarding form and any preferred PO numbering or invoice header requirements?

Elise
Elise Moran
Head of Finance Operations | WavePay
elise.moran@wavepay.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: none
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elise Moran <elise.moran@wavepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + early-pay options for WavePay

Hi Elise — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in David (payments) and Marissa (onboarding) so we can coordinate internally and give you the precise steps. Quick summary of what we'll cover:

- Procurement onboarding form and required fields for PO processing
- Invoice header / PO numbering conventions we prefer (so your AP system maps cleanly)
- Our standard net-term tiers (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60) and an early-pay pilot framework that we can propose

Deliverables:
1) I will share the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf for WavePay to fill.
2) David will outline the AP mapping and any exceptions we need to flag for early payment.
3) Marissa will propose a one-page early-pay scorecard (eligibility, discount %, cap per month, reporting cadence).

Can you confirm who on your side will own the form completion and whether AP needs a separate vendor code for test invoices? If you can return the completed form this week we can aim to have a PO and pilot terms queued by next Thursday.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
From: WavePay AP <ap@wavepay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + early-pay options for WavePay

On Wed, Nov 16, 2026 at 11:07 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elise — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in David (payments) and Marissa (onboarding) so we can coordinate internally and give you the precise steps.
> 
> Deliverables:
> 1) I will share the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf for WavePay to fill.
> 
Hello Hannah / team — thanks for the note. Elise forwarded this to me (AP lead). I attached the completed onboarding form and a brief spreadsheet that models the early-pay program (WAVE_EARLYPAY_REQUEST.xlsx). A few clarifications from our side: 

- The person completing the form is Priya Rao (procurement ops) — priya.rao@wavepay.com.
- We can tag invoices with your PO number in field: Invoice->Reference->PO. 
- For the early-pay pilot: we propose a 2% for Day10 on invoices < $50k, capped at $200k/month. We can be flexible on cap if Redwood prefers a shorter ramp.

Please confirm the account number we should reference on payment remittance and any draft contract change we should expect to sign for the pilot.

Warmly,
WavePay AP
Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf; WAVE_EARLYPAY_REQUEST.xlsx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elise Moran <elise.moran@wavepay.com>, WavePay AP <ap@wavepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + early-pay options for WavePay

Thanks Priya / Elise — received and reviewed. Next steps:

1) Marissa will ingest the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf into our vendor portal this afternoon and create a test vendor record. Expect a validation email with the temporary vendor code (V-2026-1146-T).
2) David: recommend we approve an early-pay pilot as follows: 2% Day10 for invoices < $50k, monthly cap $150k for the first 90 days, review KPIs at 60 days (payment speed, dispute rate, net-dollar impact). If AP is comfortable with $150k cap to start, we can move forward without a contract amendment and capture the pilot in an SOW addendum/email confirmation.
3) Elise: please route your first test invoice to invoices@redwood.com with the PO in the reference field. We'll confirm remittance details in the portal validation email.

For transparency, I'm dropping the proposed scorecard fields Marissa will use: eligibility criteria, discount %, cap per month, start/end dates, reporting window, contact owner. Marissa will share the one-pager and the DocuSign link to confirm the pilot enrollment.

If that all sounds good, I'll keep this thread open and mark the task in our procurement queue.

Best — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: one-pager (to follow), portal validation email
